Microsoft Copilot Studio Computer Use can run on Cloud PC pools, Microsoft hosted Windows 11 Cloud PCs that are Entra ID joined and Intune enrolled. 387ef015d855ffe39d75d3e4.text:
Design a scalable Dataverse model with ownership and controlled change

Build D365 CE data models around business concepts, then use standard Dataverse tables where they fit and custom components only for clear needs. Define relationship behaviour, data owners, system-of-record rules, stable integration identifiers, and conflict handling. Document the model, test realistic queries and updates, and deploy changes through solutions across development, test, and production environments.

Source: Softchief Technologies

Microsoft Purview DLP uses separate controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot: it can stop external web search, block sensitive prompts, exclude labeled files or emails, and reject external email sources. It does not repair permissions or inspect directly uploaded files for Sensitive Information Types through this policy location.

a30d51f658eea807ac7ee994.text:
How to Build Power Platform Data Policies Without Breaking User Apps

Power Platform DLP policies classify connectors as Business, Non-Business or Blocked. Business connectors cannot share data with Non-Business connectors, while blocked connectors cause apps and flows to fail. Admins can use separate developer and production environments, then monitor enforcement with the CoE Starter Kit and Power Platform admin center reporting.

Source: M365 FM Podcast

41467ec334df3b58ecd0467f.text:
Secure Copilot Studio agents with architecture and DLP

A Copilot Studio job application agent resisted most CV prompt injections, but a polite request exposed a tool-instruction summary in one of two runs and rapid requests still consumed credits. Send applicant data one way to Dataverse through an agent flow, limit tool calls in flows, use high moderation, and allowlist trusted connectors in DLP.

Source: Karl-Johan Spiik, Microsoft MVP
